tips.text: Buy the blueprint with leftover Creds, such as late in a series when they would otherwise expire.
Expect a few weeks of normal Nightwave play before the first Cred ranks; there is no need to rush.
Build it while farming Ferrite, Circuits and Polymer Bundle for something else; Venus drops two of the three.
Players treat the Heat Dagger as cheap early Mastery fodder that almost nobody discusses acquiring.
